scope: LONGHORN-49 narrow new linked/nested clone qualification design, not complete clone or live acceptance
classification: test-gate; existing product linked-clone StorageClass behavior, no production change or new image
product_entry: config.yml longhorn_storage_classes with clone_mode=linked-clone plus kubecli setup CLUSTER 09, followed by customer CSI PVC dataSource workflow
conclusions: The new 1.12.1 linked-clone architecture shares SPDK blocks; each child replica references one same-node/same-disk source replica. Three healthy copies and completed clone state are independent prerequisites.

Nested clone creation waits for the first clone to complete. Initial data, child-to-parent isolation and parent-to-child isolation are verified separately at both graph edges, then read again after cross-node client remount.

Pinned admission blocks source Volume deletion, entrypoint Snapshot deletion, source Replica deletion and source replica-count decrease when all replicas have dependents; a clone cannot increase above its source replica count. Use independent server dry-run refusal checks so a missing guard cannot destroy the application graph.

A separate mixed-StorageClass journal owns exact PVC/PV/Volume identities and dependency order. Remove all consumers before nested, clone and source; never pass protected entrypoints through generic snapshot-first deletion or strip finalizers. Read surviving parents after child retirement.
The current data-protection run keeps its original frozen inputs; this new helper is local-only until that run finishes and the fixed runner integration and static ladder pass.

Recovery reaches the exact owning journal before demanding an empty-volume baseline. Dangling or live symlinks, replaced namespace/PV/class identity, foreign consumers or a disappeared namespace with retained PV/native objects stop without losing the journal. The cleanup marker is distinct from business qualification. Before releasing that journal or deleting the fixture class, require the admitted empty Longhorn Volume/PV baseline again; an unbound CSI-created native object remains unidentified and must not be deleted by inferred name.
coverage_boundary: No live PASS; not full-copy source deletion, dependency eviction/rebuild, expansion/backup restore, incomplete-source creation refusal or legacy migration; these remain under LONGHORN-49.
